intro.title: Welcome to Dayopt
intro.description: Plan your time, track what you actually do, and see where your hours go. Let's walk through the basics.

gridDragPlan.title: Create a plan
gridDragPlan.description: Drag on a future time slot to schedule what you want to do

selectTagPlan.title: Pick a tag
selectTagPlan.description: Choose a tag — it becomes the name and color of your plan

explainTags.title: Tags are your titles
explainTags.description: Just pick a tag to create a plan or record. There's no title field — the tag is the name.

planVsRecord.title: Track planned vs actual
planVsRecord.description: Tap a block to manage both planned and actual time. The difference is calculated automatically.

done.title: You're all set!
done.description: Start planning your day and tracking your time
